cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(SecureFolderQR LANGUAGES CXX)
  set(SFQ_DEFAULT_PLUGIN OFF)
else()
  set(SFQ_DEFAULT_PLUGIN ON)
endif()
include(GNUInstallDirs)
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED COMPONENTS Crypto)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
option(SFQ_BUILD_PLUGIN "Build DoDevEditor module" ${SFQ_DEFAULT_PLUGIN})
set(SFQ_SDK_INCLUDE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include" CACHE PATH "DoDevEditor SDK include root")
add_library(dodev_securefolder_core STATIC src/SecureFolder.cpp src/QRMatrix.cpp)
target_include_directories(dodev_securefolder_core PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(dodev_securefolder_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(dodev_securefolder_core PUBLIC OpenSSL::Crypto ZLIB::ZLIB)
set_target_properties(dodev_securefolder_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_executable(securefolderqr src/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(securefolderqr PRIVATE dodev_securefolder_core)
if(SFQ_BUILD_PLUGIN)
  add_library(dodev_securefolder_plugin MODULE src/Plugin.cpp)
  target_include_directories(dodev_securefolder_plugin PRIVATE "${SFQ_SDK_INCLUDE}")
  target_link_libraries(dodev_securefolder_plugin PRIVATE dodev_securefolder_core)
  set(out "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/plugins/securefolderqr")
  set_target_properties(dodev_securefolder_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${out}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${out}")
  if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(dodev_securefolder_plugin PROPERTIES SUFFIX ".dylib")
  endif()
  foreach(config DEBUG RELEASE RELWITHDEBINFO MINSIZEREL)
    set_target_properties(dodev_securefolder_plugin PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${out}" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${config} "${out}")
  endforeach()
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${out}")
  configure_file(plugin.json "${out}/plugin.json" COPYONLY)
  install(TARGETS dodev_securefolder_plugin LIBRARY DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/securefolderqr" RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/securefolderqr")
  install(FILES plugin.json DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/plugins/securefolderqr")
endif()
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(securefolder_tests tests/tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(securefolder_tests PRIVATE dodev_securefolder_core)
  add_test(NAME securefolder_roundtrip COMMAND securefolder_tests)
endif()
